model._hint: Base: Manojb/stable-diffusion-2-1-base (community mirror, original Stability AI repo removed). ~2 GB; no sequential offload needed.

generation._hint: 30 steps recommended. CFG 7.5 per model card. SD 2.1 base native 512×512; 768×768 also supported.

system._hint: ~2 GB peak; sequential_cpu_offload: disabled (model fits in unified memory)

notes.about: Vanilla Stable Diffusion 2.1 base checkpoint — no LoRA, no fine-tune. Good general-purpose starting point for photorealistic and artistic prompts at 512×512.
notes.prompt_guide: Works best with detailed, descriptive prompts. Negative prompts are effective: 'blurry, low quality, deformed, watermark' helps improve output quality.
